newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MMI expands into Guam and Saipan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MMI expands into Guam and Saipan.

text.p: Insurance group MMI Ltd said on Wednesday it opened its business insurance activities in Guam through Moylan's Insurance Underwriters Inc, who will act as managing agents for MMI.
"MMI will provide commercial and personal lines insurance services through the Moylan's agency," MMI said in a statement.
MMI said Moylan's was one of the largest general insurance agencies throughout Guam, Saipan, the Northern Mariana Islands, Micronesia, Republic of Belau (Palan) and the Marshall Islands.
"MMI anticipates an initial four per cent share of the total market premium, estimated to be US$175 million," MMI said.
In December, MMI acquired a 20 percent share in Allianz Insurance (Singapore) as part of its Asian expansion plans with German general insurer, Allianz AG.
Allianz has a 38 percent stake in MMI.

"This is a further step towards building MMI's and Allianz's activities in the region. MMI will be supported by Allianz through the provision of reinsurance and other specialist services," the company said.
